stem: An analyst reports the gross MRR churn rate of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, as (churn MRR + contraction MRR - expansion MRR) / MRR at the start of the month. In a month with many upgrades the result is -0.5%. What is wrong?

options.text: Nothing: a negative gross churn shows that existing businesses grow on their own
Upgrades were netted in: gross churn counts only losses, so it is never below 0
The denominator should be the MRR at the end of the month, not the start
New-business MRR should have been added to the lost MRR as well
